_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and edit. Every value is optional —
each falls back to an env var, then ~/.snowball/config.json (user/account
only), then a built-in default. Run `sf config show` to see which tier is
NEVER put a PAT or a private key IN this file. Pass a PAT via the
